title: SQLite resultSet fails with nested query
body:
When executing a find with a nested query, the Sqlite::resultSet method includes part of the SQL statement with the result set.

SQL Statement:

```
SELECT "Recipe"."id", "Recipe"."name", "Recipe"."item_id", "Item"."id", "Item"."name", "Item"."weight", "Item"."description"
FROM "main"."recipes" AS "Recipe"
LEFT JOIN "main"."items" AS "Item" ON ("Recipe"."item_id" = "Item"."id")
WHERE "Recipe"."id" in(SELECT "Recipe"."id"
                   FROM "main"."recipes" AS Recipe
                   inner JOIN "main"."ingredients" AS Ingredient
                      ON ("Ingredient"."recipe_id" = "Recipe"."id")
                   WHERE "Recipe"."id" in(SELECT "Ingredient"."recipe_id"
                                          FROM "main"."ingredients" AS Ingredient
                                          WHERE "Ingredient"."item_id" IN (3, 8)
                                          GROUP BY "Ingredient"."recipe_id"
                                          having count(*) = 2)
                   GROUP BY "Recipe"."id"
                    having count(*) = 2)
```

Results (Notice the [Recipe" LEFT JOIN "main"] column):

```
Array
(
    [0] => Array
        (
            [Recipe] => Array
                (
                    [id] => 4
                    [name] => Salad Bowl
                    [item_id] => 10
                )
            [Item] => Array
                (
                    [id] => 10
                    [name] => Salad
                    [weight] => 0.0
                )
            [Recipe" LEFT JOIN "main"] => Array
                (
                    ["items" AS "Item" ON ("Recipe"] => A bowl of salad
                )
            [Ingredient] => Array
                (
                    [0] => Array
                        (
                            [id] => 10
                            [recipe_id] => 4
                            [item_id] => 8
                            [quantity] => 4
                            [Item] => Array
                                (
                                    [id] => 8
                                    [name] => Lettuce
                                    [weight] => 0.0
                                    [description] => Some lettuce
                                )
                        )
                    [1] => Array
                        (
                            [id] => 11
                            [recipe_id] => 4
                            [item_id] => 3
                            [quantity] => 1
                            [Item] => Array
                                (
                                    [id] => 3
                                    [name] => Wooden Bowl
                                    [weight] => 0.0
                                    [description] => A small wooden bowl
                                )
                        )
                )
        )
)
```

This is caused by resultSet searching backwards for FROM using strripos:

``` php
if (stripos($querystring, 'SELECT') === 0) {
    $last = strripos($querystring, 'FROM');
    if ($last !== false) {
        $selectpart = substr($querystring, 7, $last - 8);
        $selects = String::tokenize($selectpart, ',', '(', ')');
    }
}
```

I was able to fix this by changing the line to stripos, but I don't know what affect that would have on other applications.  

Running the Sqlite tests from Cake's core had errors in testCacheKeyName, but that occurred both with and without my change.

Code that generates my SQL query:

``` php
    protected function _findItem($state, $query, $results=array())
    {
        if ($state == 'before')
        {
            $ds = $this->getDataSource();

            $default = array_merge([
                'items' => [],
                'match' => true
            ], $query);

            $items = (array)$query['items'];
            $itemCount = count($items);          
            $match = $query['match'];

            $recipesUsingItems = $ds->buildStatement([
                    'fields' => [ 'i.recipe_id' ],
                    'table'  => $ds->fullTableName($this->Ingredient),
                    'alias'  => 'i',
                    'limit'  => null,
                    'offset' => null,
                    'joins'  => [],
                    'conditions' => [
                        'i.item_id' => $items
                    ],
                    'order' => null,
                    'group' => 'i.recipe_id having count(*) = ' . $itemCount
                ], $this->Ingredient);

            $recipesWithSameItemCount = $ds->buildStatement([
                    'fields' => [ 'r.id' ],
                    'table'  => $ds->fullTableName($this),
                    'alias'  => 'r',
                    'limit'  => null,
                    'offset' => null,
                    'joins'  => [
                        [
                            'table' => 'ingredients',
                            'alias' => 'i',
                            'type' => 'inner',
                            'conditions' => [
                                'i.recipe_id = r.id'
                            ]
                        ]
                    ],
                    'conditions' => [
                        "r.id in($recipesUsingItems)"
                    ],
                    'order' => null,
                    'group' => 'r.id having count(*) = ' . $itemCount
                ], $this);

            $options = [
                'contain' => [
                    'Item' => [
                        'fields' => ['id', 'name', 'weight', 'description' ]
                    ],
                    'Ingredient' => [
                        'Item' => [
                            'fields' => ['id', 'name', 'weight', 'description' ]
                        ]
                    ]
                ],
                'conditions' => [
                    "Recipe.id IN($recipesWithSameItemCount)"
                ]
            ];

            unset($query['items']);
            unset($query['match']);

            return Hash::merge($query, $options);
        }

        return $results;
    }
```
